title: Archive fixed-output validation of #7244
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Archive the checker and receipt from the [#7244 validation follow-up](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7244#issuecomment-6796573294). On the exact #7161 and #7244 words, all 2,229 quotient classes and 978 target classes have full rational row rank and there are zero contact-free MOVE pairs. This corroborates [#7245](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7245)'s fixed-output result on both words. [#7246](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7246) treats a complementary decoder across target classes.

The scalar replay matches all 1,499 original output rows, verifies both added outputs and rejects the dirty COPY control. The reconstructed 17-stage bill counts 22,461 productive fields and 110,553 paid positions on #7244. Directed price intervals support its existing proposal of conditional κ = 0.003645372367832 under the five retained assumptions.

## Task and overlap

This refines verification of `p104-side-correction` at base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Source commits are #7161 `e3f8d39c43b07063dfc5b800f71c5d21015259e6`, #7113 `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`, and #7244 `215f67247f395c0e15f5ea3980f6a3e4aed155af`. The archive commit adds three files and uses the exact two CI prerequisite commits from [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257).

## Validation

I fetched the exact public source commits into a fresh repository and replayed the checker with CPython 3.12.3. Its output matched the committed receipt byte for byte, with SHA-256 `5b175ee3942af01c5e9d2728486c70aae0095fea7bcec07b34c79b8ee80fe13d`. The [README](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/da481f3d12bf0a346a82411bddd9e075d72ed3db/research/p104-two-cut-fixed-output-crosscheck/README.md) gives the exact fetch and replay commands. The affected-package plan selects the historical replay from #7257. The scientific archive uses the explicit manual replay against its public PR pins.

## Credit

Credit ToikY for #7245 and #7246, Rohan Arun for #7113, Clear1nsight and the #7161/#7244 lineages, and the canonical Clifford authors. Prepared for Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Use this archive and the registered #7244 replay in the [existing frontier review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19542237). Maintainer selection and independent human or formal review remain open.
